children.name: Aplexa hypnorum
children.description: Aplexa hypnorum, or by the common name, the moss bladder snail, is a species of small air-breathing freshwater snail.

children.name: Stenophysa marmorata
children.description: Stenophysa marmorata, also known as marbled aplexa, is a species of small, air-breathing freshwater snail of the family Physidae.

children.name: Physa fontinalis
children.description: Physa fontinalis, common name the common bladder snail, is a species of air-breathing freshwater snail, an aquatic gastropod mollusc in the family Physidae.

children.name: Physa skinneri D.W.Taylor, 1954
children.description: Physa skinneri, common name the glass physa, is a species of freshwater snail, an aquatic gastropod mollusc in the family Physidae.

children.name: Physella acuta
children.description: Physella acuta, also known as the European physa, tadpole snail, sewage snail, bladder snail, or acute bladder snail, is a species of small, air-breathing freshwater snail of the family Physidae.

children.name: Physella gyrina
children.description: Physella gyrina, common name the "tadpole physa", is a species of small, left-handed or sinistral, air-breathing freshwater snail, an aquatic pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Physidae.

children.name: Physella johnsoni
children.description:
The Banff Springs snail (Physella johnsoni) is a species of small air-breathing freshwater snail in the family Physidae.
Based on molecular research, it appears that Physella johnsoni separated out as a species from Physella gyrina about 10,000 years ago.

children.name: Physella natricina
children.description:
The Snake River physa snail, scientific name Physella natricina, is a species of freshwater snail, an aquatic gastropod mollusk in the family Physidae. This species is endemic to Idaho in the United States.
The Snake River physa snail Haitia (Physa) natricina Taylor, 1988 is found in the middle Snake River of southern Idaho.

children.name: Physella spelunca
children.description:
The cave physa (Physella spelunca) is a species of small, air-breathing, freshwater snail, an aquatic pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Physidae. It lives only in caves.
This species is endemic to Big Horn County, Wyoming.

children.name: Physella zionis
children.description: The Wet rock physa, scientific name Physella zionis, is a species of freshwater snail, an aquatic pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Physidae, the bladder snails. children.name: Sibirenauta elongata
children.description: Sibirenauta elongata is a species of gastropods belonging to the family Physidae.

children.name: Sibirenauta sibirica
children.description: Sibirenauta sibirica is a species of small air-breathing freshwater snail, an aquatic pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Physidae, a family which are sometimes known as the bladder snails.
